purpose: Prespecified leave-one-band-out sensitivity diagnosis, no fitting or deployment
mask: Keep full cap150 frequency mask and weights frozen, zero one band at a time. No remasking, renormalizing or refitting cap. Subband legacy comparator uses previous frozen PHAT splitting.
rules: Full invalid remains invalid. With fewer than2 valid deletions sharing>=5 finite pairs with full, label unknown. Otherwise sensitive if max angle change>5deg or max deletion median absolute pair-delay change>0.5 samples; else stable. Strict keeps stable only. Known-only keeps stable and unknown, rejects sensitive only. Unknown pass-through is NOT a confidence endorsement. Cone-crossing perturbations reported, not used to widen or replace direction.
claim_boundary: 144 paired trials on3 fresh seeds,4 signals6 directions2 RIRs. No tuning/selection. Compare matched legacy split filter on same inputs. Coverage loss, false outside outputs, unknown pass-through risks and paired latency required.
